name: news
description: 뉴스 영향 측정 — naver_search 뉴스 결과와 일봉을 받아, 뉴스가 뜬 날 주가가 얼마나 움직였는지(D+1·D+5 수익률)를 잽니다. 대조군(전체 평일 평균)과 벤치마크(지수) 대비 초과수익을 함께 내서, '오르게 한 뉴스인지'가 감이 아니라 측정이 되게 합니다. 유사 제목은 묶고 날짜별 보도량 타임라인도 냅니다. 수집은 naver_search, 해석은 대화 몫.

actions.name: 뉴스일 주가 반응 측정 (D+1·D+5, 대조군 동반)
actions.description: News items (naver_search shape) + daily bars in -> per-news-day forward returns from the pre-news close, clustered by similar titles, with the all-days average as the control and optional benchmark-relative excess returns

params.bars: daily OHLCV rows of the stock (or barsCacheKey)
params.benchmarkBars: optional index bars for excess return (or benchmarkBarsCacheKey)

actions.name: 보도량 타임라인·유사기사 묶기 (봉 불필요)
actions.description: News items in -> daily counts, clusters of near-duplicate titles, sources. No bars needed.

actions.name: 셀프테스트
actions.description: Offline checks with synthetic news and bars with known answers.

action.description: impact = news + daily bars -> measured reaction with a control. timeline = counts + clusters only. selftest = offline checks.

items.description: News rows as naver_search returns them: {title, link, description, pubDate}. Other shapes work if they carry a title and an RFC-2822 or ISO date field.

itemsCacheKey.description: The `_cacheKey` from the naver_search news call — hands the items over without re-inlining.

bars.description: Daily OHLCV rows of the stock, any broker dialect — a date-like field (date/time/stck_bsop_date/...) and a close-like field (close/clpr/stck_clpr/trade_price/...) are found by name.

benchmarkBars.description: Optional index daily bars (e.g. KOSPI) — enables benchmark-relative excess returns. Without it, raw returns are labeled as raw.

benchmarkBarsCacheKey.description: The `_cacheKey` from the index candle call.

horizons.description: Forward horizons in trading days. Default [1, 5].
